doc.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999

title: Constant travel schedule
summary: He travels constantly, home only half the month, and stays healthy.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: That’s terrific. What does the future bring for you the rest of this year? Are you going to be traveling more?
How many months out of the year do you usually travel?

Oh, domestic schedule is very tight and maybe half a month I can stay in Tokyo and then half went to other cities traveling. Last November and December I only three days stayed in my home. Just like a gypsy. And I brought along my very big bag and my instrument — every day a changed city. But I’m very happy. My body is very strong, very, very strong. I’m never sick.
